summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology, NY. Built autonomous perception and control pipelines validated in CARLA simulation (zero collisions) and on hardware, including TensorRT-optimized YOLO visual servoing at 92 FPS on Jetson. Experienced in C++, Python, sensor integration, and real-time systems.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for real-time visual servoing, plus dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping (gripper close at 25 mm).

Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through hardware debugging; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller over WebSockets.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service with auto-restart and non-root isolation on headless Linux.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Validated the autonomous driving stack in CARLA simulation (Town02, 30 vehicles, 10 pedestrians): zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Built a real-time object tracker: YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson sends control commands to STM32 over UART; FreeRTOS with mutexes for task coordination, interrupt-driven multi-servo PWM control, and VL53L0X ToF sensing.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed a Cortex-M4 in bare-metal C (ADC, TIM2, I2C1, interrupts) in 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Ran collision-free trajectory planning and pick-and-place on a physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver.
